trigger.description: ee pack finds an L2 cache entry for the canonical pack key, but the entry payload is malformed, has the wrong schema, mismatches the key, or fails body-hash validation. The corrupt entry is ignored and fresh pack assembly proceeds.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Run cargo fmt before release.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule
CACHE_ENTRY="$(find "$EE_L2_PACK_CACHE_DIR" -type f -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort | sed -n '1p')"; test -n "$CACHE_ENTRY"

expected_emission.repair_string: Remove the corrupt cache entry or lower the L2 cache TTL.
